texts.arguments: The petitioner in this writ petition assails the action of the opposite parties in issuing the letter dated 23.09.2020 (Annexure-1) issued by the Advisor (Science and Standards), Food Safety and Standards Authority of India and the letter dated 25.09.2020 (Annexure-2) issued by the Deputy Director/Central Licensing Authority, Food Safety and Standards Authority of India- opposite No.2, requesting the petitioner to refrain from all the activities, such as, manufactureing, repacking trading selling, storing of Blended, Edible Vegetable Oil with Mustard Oil with effect from 01st October, 2020. Mr. Mohanty, learned Senior Advocate for the petitioner submits that on the basis of a draft notification namely, the Draft Food Safety and Standards (Prohibition and Restrictions on Sales) Amendment Regulations, 2020, the letters under Annexures-1 and 2 have been issued. It is further submitted that the authorities have every right to put restrictions as detailed in Annexure-2 following due procedure of law. But, in absence of any 2 law to that effect the authorities under the Food Safety and Standards Authority of India have no jurisdiction to issue such letters. They have purportedly acted under a draft notification which is per se illegal. When no such notification has yet been issued, the authority could not have restricted the lawful activities of the petitioner under the umbrella a draft notification. He, therefore, prays for a direction to stay operation of the letters under Annexures- 1 and 2. Mr. Bose, learned Assistant Solicitor General for the opposite party No.1, on the other hand, submits 3 that the Central Government is competent to make the rules and issue notification for regulating the Food Safety and Standards. Accordingly, a draft notification has been issued prohibiting blending of edible vegetable oil with mustard oil. It is clearly stated therein that it will be effective from 1st October, 2020. Accordingly, Annexures- 1 & 2 have been issued. He, however, submits that he will take instructions in the matter and file a detail counter affidavit.
